ota.summary: Fixes from the second and third code reviews: a hold pause now survives a restart; tapping Heat during a quiet hold (in Frosty or a home app) keeps the hold's setpoint; the dial shows a new quiet hold at once; Follow Me warns earlier when the room sensor goes quiet; the louvre comes back after a hold you took over; schedule times no longer repeat when the clocks go back and still run when they go forward; home apps show the right setpoint; installs, checks and rescue updates no longer overlap; a stronger block on requests from other websites; clearer update and rescue messages.
